title: Processes
description: Bind actions to PID and process start identity, not PID alone.
notes: Shared review selector covers loading/empty/invalid/unauthorized/unsupported/disconnected/stale and mutation preview/expired/running/refused/failed/unknown/verified/mismatch/unavailable.
Only capability-delivered, policy-permitted changes enable exact-action preview; backend authorizes independently. Unknown-after-submit offers read-only reconciliation.
Stale PID/start mismatch invalidates intent; refresh identity before signal. Exact SIGTERM and privilege are shown. No promise to stop all descendants.
Unsupported process inspection disables mutation. Bounded sorted table; keyboard row detail provides full arguments as plain text.
